description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Sam LaPorta (ankle) is practicing Tuesday for the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: LaPorta is progressing in the right direction on a short week, as the tight end looks to clear through any tests to suit up against the Chicago Bears on Thanksgiving Day. The tight end remains an impactful intermediate pass-catching option as part of a dynamic Lions offense when healthy.
items.title: Sam LaPorta (ankle) practicing Tuesday

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Denzel Boston (toe) did not take part in Tuesday's practice session.
items.impact: The Browns are coming off a bye week and have until Sunday night to get ready for the Raiders. That will hopefully leave enough time for Boston to be ready, but this is not an encouraging start to the practice week for the rookie wideout. If Boston cannot go, Jerry Jeudy would likely see his snaps go up.
items.title: Denzel Boston (toe) not practicing Tuesday

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Micah Parsons (knee) marked questionable for Wednesday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Parsons has yet to suit up for the Packers so far this season, but that is largely expected to change this week despite the questionable tag.
items.title: Micah Parson (knee) listed as questionable for Week 12

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Josh Jacobs (finger) has been listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: With the Packers coming off a bye week, Jacobs practiced in limited fashion Monday and was listed as questionable Tuesday. If Jacobs is ruled out, the trio of Chris Brooks, Kaleb Johnson, and MarShawn Lloyd would likely split the backfield load for the Packers once again.
items.title: Josh Jacobs (finger) questionable for Wednesday's game

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Kenneth Walker III (groin) will practice for the Kansas City Chiefs Tuesday according to Nate Taylor.
items.impact: Walker III will see limited work on the practice field, as the dynamic running back looks to return from a two-game absence against the Buffalo Bills Thanksgiving night. Emmett Johnson would be in line for an RB1 role if Walker III is unable to progress enough on a limited practice week for head coach Andy Reid against the Bills.
items.title: Kenneth Walker III (groin) practicing Tuesday

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Colbie Young caught one of his two targets for a four-yard touchdown in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11's Monday night game.
items.impact: The rookie hauled in a touchdown pass from Joe Burrow in the third quarter for the first touchdown catch of his career. Young now has three receptions for 13 yards in eight games for the Bengals this season as he looks to carve out a larger role in the Cincy passing attack. He will face the Saints in Week 12.
items.title: Colbie Young catches TD in Week 11

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: The Commanders D/ST allowed 20 points while picking up three sacks in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11's Monday night game.
items.impact: On a rainy night at Northwest Stadium, Washington's defense was impressive in slowing down a red-hot Cincinnati offense that had scored at least 31 points in five straight games coming into Week 11. The Commanders will be a solid fantasy defense option heading into a Week 12 matchup against a struggling Arizona offense.
items.title: Commanders D/ST holds Bengals to 20 points in Week 11

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Drew Stevens made all five of his field-goal attempts and added an extra point in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11.
items.impact: Stevens was busy on a rainy night at Northwest Stadium, hitting field goals from 36, 40, 25, 41, and 26 yards out. His final field goal was the game-winner as time expired. Stevens has now made 22 of his 25 field-goal attempts and added 16 extra points this year. He will take on the Cardinals in Week 12.
items.title: Drew Stevens hits game-winning FG in Week 11

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Chig Okonkwo caught four of his five targets for 66 yards in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11.
items.impact: Okonkwo finished second on the Commanders in receiving in the win on Monday night. He did most of his damage on a 32-yard catch-and-run in the second quarter, which helped set up a one-yard touchdown run for Jacory Croskey-Merritt. Okonkwo has caught 31 passes for 329 yards through eight games for the Commanders this season. He will be a TE2 in Week 12 vs. the Cardinals.
items.title: Chig Okonkwo goes for 66 yards in Week 11

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Treylon Burks caught two of his three targets for 30 yards in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11.
items.impact: Burks was quiet, although he drew a pass interference flag on an end zone target in the second quarter, setting up Jacory Croskey-Merritt's one-yard touchdown run. Burks has caught 16 passes for 290 yards and two touchdowns in eight games this year. He will not be a recommended fantasy option in Week 12 vs. the Cardinals.
items.title: Treylon Burks goes for 30 yards in Week 11

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Antonio Williams caught nine of his 11 targets for 122 yards in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11's Monday night game.
items.impact: The rookie exploded in the win, posting the first 100-yard receiving game of his career while also setting a career high in receptions. With less than a minute left in regulation, Williams caught two long passes from Jayden Daniels to set up the game-winning field goal. He is looking like a strong WR3 in fantasy heading into a Week 12 matchup vs. the Cardinals.
items.title: Antonio Williams posts nine catches, 122 yards in MNF win

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Stefon Diggs caught four of his six targets for 45 yards in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11's Monday night game.
items.impact: Diggs was third on the Commanders in receiving in the close win over Cincinnati. The veteran wideout now has 40 catches for 431 yards and six touchdowns in nine games for the Commanders this season. He will be a WR3 option in Week 12 vs. the Cardinals.
items.title: Stefon Diggs goes for 45 yards in MNF win

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Austin Ekeler carried the ball seven times for 41 yards and caught two of three targets for three yards in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11's Monday night game.
items.impact: Ekeler played behind Jacory Croskey-Merritt but he still did damage on the ground, averaging 5.9 yards per carry in the win. Ekeler remains a solid piece of Washington's running-back rotation. He will be a low-end flex option in Week 12 vs. the Cardinals.
items.title: Austin Ekeler runs for 41 yards in Week 11

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Rachaad White did not receive any touches in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11.
items.impact: White came into the game managing a heel injury but he ultimately suited up and played on 15 snaps. The return of Jacory Croskey-Merritt from injured reserve certainly cut into White's workload, as the former led the Commanders' backfield with 15 touches. White is looking like a fantasy cut candidate heading into a Week 12 matchup vs. the Cardinals.
items.title: Rachaad White does not see any touches in Week 11

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Jacory Croskey-Merritt carried the ball 13 times for 54 yards and a touchdown while catching two of his three targets for 23 yards in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11's Monday night game.
items.impact: Croskey-Merritt made his return to action after a multi-week absence due to a groin injury. He went right back to leading the Commanders' backfield, scoring on a one-yard touchdown run in the second quarter. The veteran will be a solid fantasy RB2 in Week 12 against the Cardinals in a plus matchup.
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt finds the end zone in Week 11

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Jayden Daniels completed 23 of his 35 passes for 289 yards and added six rushes for 55 yards in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11's Monday night game.
items.impact: Daniels and the Washington offense got off to a slow start on a rainy night at Northwest Stadium as they didn't score their first points until the second quarter. That being said, with the Commanders trailing 20-19, Daniels completed two long passes to Antonio Williams with less than a minute left in the game to set up a game-winning 26-yard field goal. Daniels has thrown for 10 touchdowns and two interceptions while adding 335 rushing yards and two scores on the ground in eight games this year. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 12 vs. the Cardinals.
items.title: Jayden Daniels throws for 289 yards in MNF win

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: The Bengals D/ST allowed 22 points while picking up three sacks in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11's Monday night game.
items.impact: Cincinnati held the Commanders to just one touchdown in the game, but they allowed Jayden Daniels to complete two long passes to set up a game-winning field goal with less than a minute left in regulation. They will look to bounce back in Week 12 vs. the Saints.
items.title: Bengals D/ST allows 22 points in Week 11 loss

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Evan McPherson made both of his field-goal attempts and added two extra points in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11.
items.impact: McPherson hit what looked like it was going to be a game-winning 56-yard field goal with 50 seconds left in regulation but Washington was able to rally back to hit a game-winning field goal of their own. McPherson has now made 15 of his 16 field-goal attempts and added 35 extra points this season. He will kick against the Saints in Week 12.
items.title: Evan McPherson makes two FGs in Week 11 loss

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Mike Gesicki caught five of his six targets for 77 yards in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11.
items.impact: Gesicki led the Bengals in receiving in the Monday night loss, doing most of his damage on a 32-yard reception in the fourth quarter to help set up a 56-yard field goal. Gesicki now has 25 catches for 338 yards and six touchdowns in 10 games this season. He will be a low-end TE2 in Week 12 vs. the Saints.
items.title: Mike Gesicki leads Bengals in receiving in Week 11

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Dohnte Meyers caught one of his two targets for two yards in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11.
items.impact: Meyers was quiet in the close loss in a game where Joe Burrow spread the ball around to nine different pass-catchers. The rookie wideout will continue to be boom/bust as the No. 3 receiver in Cincinnati. Sitting on 21 catches for 244 yards and one touchdown in 10 games this year, he gets the Saints in Week 12.
items.title: Dohnte Meyers held to one catch in Week 11

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Tee Higgins caught two of his three targets for 43 yards and a touchdown in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11's Monday night game.
items.impact: Higgins was mostly quiet in the game despite Joe Burrow throwing for 300 yards. That being said, he made an excellent catch in the end zone on his 31-yard touchdown reception from Burrow in the second quarter. Higgins now has 55 catches for 867 yards and seven touchdowns through 10 games this year. He will be a solid fantasy WR1 in Week 12 vs. the Saints.
items.title: Tee Higgins finds the end zone in Week 11

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase caught five of his nine targets for 31 yards in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11.
items.impact: Chase led the team in targets but was unable to get much going on a rainy night, averaging just 6.2 yards per catch. The star wideout now has 69 catches for 909 yards and seven touchdowns through 10 games this year. He will be a top-three fantasy WR in Week 12 vs. the Saints.
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase held to 31 yards in Week 11

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Samaje Perine carried the ball six times for 26 yards and caught all four of his targets for 71 yards in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11.
items.impact: Perine led the Bengals in rushing while finishing second on the team in receiving in the close loss. The team continues to mix Perine in on offense behind Chase Brown, giving him low-end flex value in fantasy most weeks. He will now prepare to take on the Saints in Week 12.
items.title: Samaje Perine leads Bengals in rushing in Week 11

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Chase Brown carried the ball six times for six yards and caught five of his eight targets for 30 yards in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11.
items.impact: Brown and Samaje Perine both saw six carries in the Monday night loss. The Bengals continue to split work between the two, although Brown's eight targets were second on the team in the close loss. Brown has rushed for 447 yards while adding 52 catches for 276 yards and three all-purpose touchdowns through 10 games this season. He will be a low-end RB1 in fantasy heading into Week 12 vs. the Saints.
items.title: Chase Brown held to six rushing yards in Week 11

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Joe Burrow completed 28 of his 40 passes for 300 yards and two touchdowns in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11.
items.impact: Burrow and the Cincy offense got off to a slow start on a rainy night at Northwest Stadium as they didn't score their first points until the second quarter.  His first touchdown pass went to Tee Higgins in the second quarter, while his second was a four-yard completion to Colbie Young in the third. The game on Monday night was the first time Burrow didn't throw for at least three touchdowns since Week 4 vs. Jacksonville. He will be a top-three fantasy QB in Week 12 against the Saints.
items.title: Joe Burrow throws two TDs in Week 11 loss
